name: Fill Borders
description: Fills the borders of the picture by smearing, mirroring, reflecting, wrapping, fading or with a fixed color.

params.name: left
params.description: Width of the left border in pixels

params.name: right
params.description: Width of the right border in pixels

params.name: top
params.description: Height of the top border in pixels

params.name: bottom
params.description: Height of the bottom border in pixels

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 = smear, 1 = mirror, 2 = fixed, 3 = reflect, 4 = wrap, 5 = fade

params.name: color
params.description: Color for the fixed and fade modes
